peopleAlsoAsk.question: How to store Newcastle vaccine?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: The I-2 Newcastle disease vaccine is more robust and is known as a thermostable vaccine. Thermostable vaccines still require long-term storage in the refrigerator. However during transportation of the vaccine to the field, the vaccine will not deteriorate as quickly as the traditional vaccines.

peopleAlsoAsk.question: What is the thermal stability of Newcastle disease virus in poultry litter?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: At high temperatures (37.8 C-43.3 C), infectious virus could not be detected after 2-7 days, whereas at lower temperatures (10 C-21.1 C), it took up to 112 days for virus to decrease to undetectable levels. Furthermore, the D values were almost always shorter in the high moisture litter.Apr 5, 2022

peopleAlsoAsk.question: Can you store vaccines at 10 degrees?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: This helps to prevent complete stock wastage should a single fridge fail. A validated medical / pharmacy vaccine fridge must be used to ensure that stored vaccines are maintained within the +2°C to +8°C temperature range. The ideal temperature for a vaccine fridge is 5°C, this ensures there is leeway of ±3°C.
